How Enable/Disable Member Dashboard Forms per Membership Plan
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000681812
This article explains how to identify and then enable or disable member dashboard forms for each membership plan.

## About Member Dashboard Forms
By default, three forms are displayed in the member dashboard:

## Identify Forms Currently Used
These forms can be enabled or disabled by navigating to:
• Finance section
• Click  Membership Plans
• Then click 'Edit' for the membership plan to be modified.

## Go to Member's Dashboard tab
Under the Member's Dashboard tab, member dashboard forms can be enabled or disabled.

## Example: Disabling a Form
In this example, the Additional Details and About Me forms are disabled as shown above.
